job.job_description:
We are seeking a Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience in building scalable web applications using React on the front end and Python (FastAPI / Django) on the backend. The candidate should have strong problem-solving skills, a solid understanding of databases, and the ability to deliver clean, maintainable code.

Key Responsibilities
Develop responsive web interfaces and reusable components in React
Build and maintain RESTful APIs in Python (FastAPI / Django)
Ensure code quality, performance, and scalability
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI/LLM models into applications.
Required Skillsets
Next.js
React.js
JavaScript (ES6+)
HTML5
CSS3
Python (FastAPI / Django)
RESTful APIs
MySQL / PostgreSQL
Familiarity with AI technologies and LLM model integration

Experience working with Agile and DevOps.

Qualification

Computer Science or relevant engineering graduation
